rifampin.notes: Dual OATP1B1 substrate + inhibitor; the single-dose IV 600 mg measurement avoids chronic-induction confounds of repeat dosing. Tirona et al 2003 JPET 305:1028 establishes OATP1B1 substrate role at plasma concentrations in this range. MW 822 is above the 800 Da threshold commonly used for AD flagging — engine may flag in_domain=False. This is fine; the N50 is for generalization measurement, not domain restriction.

irinotecan.notes: Nozawa et al 2005 DMD 33:434 established OATP1B1 substrate role. Cmax reported here is for parent irinotecan only (not SN-38 active metabolite). SN-38 is formed by intracellular CES1/2 hydrolysis and is the pharmacologically active species, but clinical Cmax of SN-38 is 0.0263 mg/L — not what our engine would try to predict from a dose of irinotecan. Per spec §A1, we evaluate parent Cmax only. Prodrug-to-metabolite dynamics are a DDI/metabolism question explicitly out of scope.

caspofungin.notes: Sandhu et al 2005 AAC 49:2602 establishes OATP1B1 substrate role. Large cyclic lipopeptide MW 1093 — will trigger AD flag for molecular weight. Acceptable. Primary source reports geometric mean with 90% CI (not arithmetic mean ± SD). C₁ₕ column in Table 1: 12.04 μg/mL = 12.04 mg/L with 90% CI [10.87, 13.33]. N=6 enrolled at 70 mg dose panel, Cmax value available for n=5 (one missing per the paper). SD field is null; CI fields report the primary-source 90% CI.
